page.overview:
Who is Blizzaurus?

Blizzaurus is an ice dragon and a boss who appears in Super Princess Peach. Her name is a portmanteau of "blizzard" and the suffix "-saurus". She is battled at the end of World 6, Gleam Glacier.

At first, Blizzaurus appears as a giant cyan dragon-type boss with a blue mane, but her true form is revealed to be a sprite-like creature. In her fairy form, Blizzaurus has light blue skin and wears a sleeveless dress and a golden headband with pink orbs on it. She carries a golden wand that lets her perform magic attacks.

When Princess Peach enters the boss room, she sees an imprisoned Toad (or a stash of Coins if she completed the level beforehand). Blizzaurus catches the princess off guard with her ice breath and then charges, breaking her free and beginning the fight proper.

During battle, Blizzaurus mainly attacks with her massive body by charging directly at Peach. She can also create glaciers from the ground. She has an ice beam that freezes anything touching it. Princess Peach can deal damage onto Blizzaurus' ice shield by using her Rage vibe. Successfully breaking Blizzaurus' ice shield causes her to lose a hit point; when this happens, Blizzaurus rears back in pain as she gains crosses for eyes.
